sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale yellow, darker near the anterior margin (yellowish brown); the sides almost parallel, slightly broader anteriorly; the anterior projection (frontal projection) larger than in nigritus Silvestri, densely hairy; head stouter (higher) than in nigritus, with sparse long and short hairs. Labrum yellow, elongate, with a narrow elongate lateral lobe on each side, concave in the middle, with long hairs. Mandibles black, elongate, slender, curved, the tips incurved. Antennae yellowish brown, 14 segments, covered with short hairs: segment 3 shorter than segment 2, slightly longer than segment 4; from segment 5 onwards the segments gradually longer and broader towards the apex; terminal segment elongate, narrow, acute at the tip. Pronotum white with a yellow tinge, saddle-shaped, the anterior margin slightly concave, with long hairs. Legs white with a yellow tinge, the claws brown, elongate, slender, hairy. Abdomen dirty greyish white with a yellow tinge, covered with dense short hairs, the base of the tergites with an additional row of long hairs. Measurements: soldier total length 5.1—5.6 mm; head length including mandibles 2.90—3.3 mm; head length (excluding mandibles, to the anterior margin) 1.50 mm; left mandible length 1.80 mm; pronotum length 0.30 mm; hind tibia length 0.85 mm; greatest head width 0.90—0.95 mm; pronotum width 0.60 mm. Large individuals have a paler, stouter head and longer mandibles.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Originally published as Mirotermes panamaensis, new species; type locality Barro Colorado Island, Panama Canal Zone (collected by Zetek). Placed in the genus Termes in the checklist, the generic assignment following the later revision on which the checklist is based.
